## Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2. Include a model number and part/assembly number when submitting the test plan to the supplier.
3. Include the test plan description in the test data and supply a test record in the field of test data submitted by the customer, if needed.
4. Also, if a testplan is included in the field of test data submitted by the customer, then it must be a copy of the test plan. If a testplan is not included in the field of test data submitted by the customer, supply an electronic copy of the test plan.
